answer: My answer to sybils is Entrusted foster carer licence with fostering agency attestation — a licence the agency renews after placement audits — which makes the willow of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a licence the agency renews after placement audits is something they already have; the dune falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the horizon of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
